items.headline: Apple Draws $31 Billion of Orders for High-Grade Bond Sale
items.excerpt: Apple Inc. has attracted solid demand and lowered borrowing costs on its investment-grade bond sale, luring investors seeking a break from a glut of AI-related debt offerings despite a broader selloff across markets.

items.headline: Duke Sees Data-Center Growth Even Amid Backlash Across the US
items.excerpt: Duke Energy Corp. is forecasting a data-center boom in regions it serves even amid the backlash that threatens the growth of the AI facilities elsewhere in the country.

items.headline: AI Selloff Has Room to Go on Mechanical Selling, Says Academy’s Tchir
items.excerpt: Peter Tchir, head of macro strategy at Academy Securities, explains the market factors he sees deepening the selloff on the AI trade as he expects the US economy to slow without increased compute spend. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Anthropic, Plaid Collaborate on AI Consumer Finance Guidance
items.excerpt: Anthropic PBC is tapping the fintech Plaid and its vast network of consumer finance information to bring more tailored financial guidance to users of its Claude artificial intelligence model.

items.headline: AI Investment Bust Seen Less Likely With Data-Center Backlash
items.excerpt: The backlash against data centers evident in this week’s US midterm elections raises new risks for a key source of economic growth. But restrictions on development could ultimately reduce the odds of a downturn by keeping the AI investment boom in check.

items.excerpt: Apple is finally bringing some of Siri's most ambitious AI capabilities to the iPhone. In this episode of Power On, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman and Vlad Savov break down the major changes coming with iOS 27.3, including Siri's new ability to control apps, carry out complex tasks and coordinate actions

items.headline: Google AI in School Triggered Teen’s Mental Health Crisis, Lawsuit Says
items.excerpt: Parents in North Carolina sued Google after their 13-year-old daughter spent months discussing suicidal thoughts with the company’s artificial intelligence tools on her school-issued Chromebook, underscoring the potential risks of the technology as parents and educators debate AI’s place in schools.

items.headline: Colony: AI Investment Will Continue Despite Tech Selloff
items.excerpt: George Colony, Forrester Research Founder, Chairman & CEO says the AI boom may be entering a new phase. items.excerpt: As the cost of capital rises, David N. Miller says private markets still see opportunity, from flexible financing for hard-to-refinance assets to infrastructure beyond the AI boom. He discusses AI's long-term potential, concentration risks, and why selectivity matters for investors. (Source:

items.excerpt: Rio Tinto is committing $144 million to advance the Resolution Copper project in Arizona, funding additional drilling, engineering and infrastructure work. items.headline: How Musk’s Starlink Can Challenge AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile
items.excerpt: Elon Musk’s SpaceX has already transformed the internet-from-space business. Now, he’s taking on another entrenched industry with plans for a terrestrial wireless network to rival Verizon Communications Inc., T-Mobile US Inc. and AT&T Inc.

items.headline: Oracle Data Center Developer Waives Key Air Permit Deadline
items.excerpt: The developer of power infrastructure for Oracle Corp.’s New Mexico data center agreed to delay a deadline for action on a key air permit, giving state environmental regulators more time to review it rather than deny the application.

items.headline: State-Driven Data Center Backlash Reshaping the AI Trade
items.excerpt: The Democratic sweep of Congress and a handful of governor races sent stock prices spiraling for so-called neoclouds. items.headline: AI Selloff Is a 'Modest Wave' in a Multiyear Cycle, Bernstein's Chaloff Says
items.excerpt: Bernstein Private Wealth Management CIO Alex Chaloff says the selloff in AI stocks is creating buying opportunities in the market. He speaks on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Microsoft Sours on Neoclouds IREN, Nebius, Nscale on Delays, Costs
items.excerpt: Microsoft Corp. helped create the “neocloud” boom, signing tens of billions of dollars in contracts with upstart data center operators in an effort to sate the crushing appetite for its cloud and AI services.

items.headline: Sony Debuts Retro $60 Wired Headphones in Tribute to 1979 Walkman
items.excerpt: Sony Group Corp. introduced an inexpensive pair of wired headphones, joining a growing trend in what it called “a nod to both the ’80s Walkman era and today’s retro tech revival.”

items.headline: Shield AI To Hit $28.8 Billion Value With $5.3 Billion Radar Acquisition
items.excerpt: Defense tech startup set to acquire Echodyne Corp., which sells radar sensors to government and commercial customers.

items.headline: Chipmakers Selloff Leads Nasdaq 100 Down 5%
items.excerpt: Sarah Hunt, Alpine Saxon Woods chief market strategist, reacts to the chipmaker selloff which pulled down the Nasdaq 100 by 5% in early trading on Thursday.
